tasks.title: Reproduce the defect
tasks.goal: Observe the reported failure before modifying code and record exact reproduction evidence.
acceptance: The failure is reproduced with exact steps, or inability to reproduce is explicitly reported.
Expected and actual behavior are distinct.
verification: Capture runtime evidence for the failing path.

tasks.title: Establish causal root cause
tasks.goal: Trace the failing path and determine the causal mechanism rather than patching the first suspicious symptom.
acceptance: Root cause is supported by code or runtime evidence.
Plausible adjacent causes have been considered.
verification: Document causal chain with repository paths and evidence.

tasks.title: Encode failing regression
tasks.goal: Create the strongest stable regression test or repeatable verification recipe before the fix.
acceptance: The test/recipe fails for the reproduced reason before the fix.
verification: Run it pre-fix and store the failure evidence.

tasks.title: Apply smallest causal fix
tasks.goal: Change the minimum necessary code to address the root cause.
acceptance: The change addresses the causal mechanism.
Unrelated behavior is not intentionally changed.

tasks.title: Run regression and surrounding checks
tasks.goal: Run the regression proof plus relevant deterministic test/static gates.
verification: Produce structured passing evidence with exact commands.

tasks.title: Replay original failure path
tasks.goal: Repeat the exact original runtime reproduction after the fix.
acceptance: Expected behavior and side effects are observed.
verification: Capture before/after runtime evidence using the same path.

tasks.title: Challenge the bug fix
tasks.goal: Look for hidden regressions, incomplete causal fixes, boundary failures and new security/reliability risks.
acceptance: Blocking findings are resolved or the task remains blocked.

tasks.title: Integrate verified fix
tasks.goal: Resolve review findings, rerun invalidated evidence and prepare closeout.
acceptance: Both failure and resolution evidence are linked.
